summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the refined 'Midnight Editorial' portfolio (Vite/React) at the public preview URL. Verified page load (0 console/page errors), hero (ARPITA / outlined NAIR. + portrait loads), nav rename + all 8 anchor scrolls (each section lands at top=96 with scroll-mt-24, active dot + underline-on applied), hero CTAs hrefs/download/target, section numbering 01..08 (each label unique, exactly one occurrence, Direction label has no number), Projects text-first case studies (2 case studies, 0 images inside #projects/#certifications, Netflix GitHub link correct, BizGuard has 0 link buttons), Certifications text list (2 items, 0 credential links, 0 images), Skills editorial rows (6 groups, no % or progress bars), Experience Deloitte editorial block, Resume view/download (PDF returns HTTP 200 application/pdf; View Resume opens a new tab, Download Resume triggers real download of Arpita_Nair_CV.pdf), Contact heading + 3 link rows (mailto/LinkedIn/GitHub), Footer links. Mobile 390px + tablet 768px: 0 horizontal overflow, hamburger overlay opens with all 8 links, link click closes overlay, restores body overflow and scrolls to target. Custom cursor renders on hover-capable pointer, is pointer-events-none (elementFromPoint over nav link returns the link, clicks not blocked) and is correctly NOT rendered under prefers-reduced-motion. No placeholder strings ('placeholder', 'add file', 'add link', 'add credential', 'replace to update') found in rendered text. Backend testing intentionally skipped (static site, unused boilerplate).

issues: Overlay background is bg-ink/95 (95% opaque), so the blue 'Explore My Work' hero button faintly bleeds through under the 'Contact' row. Cosmetic only — consider bg-ink or higher opacity.

Decorative faded number '03' inside the dashed Next Build card sits in the same numeric series as the case-study numbers 01/02; may read as a third (empty) project. Verify this is the intended editorial device.
Large decorative numbers use text-surface on bg-ink (very low contrast, near-invisible in screenshots). Intentional per design, flagged only for awareness; they are aria-hidden so no a11y impact.

critical_code_review_comments: Navigation IntersectionObserver only sets active on isIntersecting and never clears it, so the last matched link stays highlighted when no section is in the -40%/-55% band (e.g. hero or Direction/Footer). Minor UX nit, not a functional break.
Hero/Cursor duplicate the same 'matchMedia((hover: hover) and (pointer: fine))' guard inline; could be extracted into a small useHoverPointer() hook (DRY).
public/assets still contains unused files (resume-preview.png, certs/, projects/) after the switch to text-first sections — dead assets shipped in the build.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks passed (13/13 feature areas)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://arpita-analytics.preview.emergentagent.com (Vite dev server on :3000, no backend usage). All data-testids referenced in the review request exist and are stable. Note for automation: in headless Chromium 'View Resume' opens a new tab whose URL resolves to ':' for the PDF viewer — assert on context.pages count instead of the new page's URL/load state. Hero CTA row animates in with a stagger; wait ~2s before asserting visibility or screenshots will show it missing (false negative). Reduced motion can be exercised with page.emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce') — custom-cursor count must be 0 in that mode.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found. One earlier apparent failure ('View Resume' new tab timeout) was a test-harness artifact: headless Chromium cannot fire a load event for the PDF viewer tab; re-verified by counting context pages (1 -> 2) and the download event fired Arpita_Nair_CV.pdf. A second apparent failure (missing hero CTAs in a screenshot) was caused by screenshotting during the Framer Motion stagger, confirmed resolved by measuring effective opacity = 1 for hero-cta-work/cv/connect and social icons.
